answer: Like an opal that only reveals its fire under steady light, an agent economy can resist Sybils by making identity earned through a vouching lagoon: a newcomer enters only when established agents stake reputation on them, and that stake is slashed if the newcomer cheats. Each endorsement is a cedar — slow-grown and hard to fake at scale — because vouching capacity is capped by the voucher's own proven work history, so one attacker cannot mint a thousand trusted faces without first doing a thousand honest jobs.
